info.name: Appointment Platform Backend
info.description: Requests grouped by feature. Manual setup: Authentication > Session > Get CSRF, Authentication > Login > Brand Login OR Admin Login, then Authentication > Session > Refresh CSRF After Login. Choose the feature folder next. Variables are shared at collection level. Validation Checks contain expected errors. Do not run the entire collection as one scenario; registration requires an email token and logins switch roles.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: For manual use: Session > Get CSRF, Login > choose one role, Session > Refresh CSRF After Login. Do not run the entire collection as one scenario.

item.name: Session
item.description: Get CSRF before login; refresh it after login. Postman stores JSESSIONID automatically.

request.description: Creates/uses the current HTTP session and saves its CSRF token into collection variables. Run before registration, verification or login.

exec: pm.test('CSRF response contains token and header name', () => {

request.description: Fetches the new CSRF token bound to the authenticated session after session fixation protection rotates the session ID.
Returns the account represented by the current JSESSIONID session. Expected status: 200 when logged in, 401 otherwise.

exec: pm.test('Account has id and role', () => { const account = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(account.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(account.role).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Invalidates the server-side session and deletes JSESSIONID. Requires the current CSRF token. Expected status: 204.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')) throw new Error('Fetch or refresh CSRF first.');

item.name: Registration
item.description: Get CSRF first. Register, then copy the email token into verificationToken and verify.

request.description: Starts account and brand registration. Verification creates no branch. After login, use Branches > Create Branch to enter address and weekly working hours.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')) throw new Error('Run Authentication > Session > Get CSRF first.');

request.description: Completes email verification with the 43-character token extracted from the verification link. Expected status: 204.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')) throw new Error('Run Authentication > Session > Get CSRF first.');
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('verificationToken')) throw new Error('Set verificationToken from the verification email first.');

item.name: Login
item.description: Choose Brand Login OR Admin Login. These are alternatives, not consecutive steps. Refresh CSRF after a successful login.

request.description: Logs in a verified brand account. Successful login rotates JSESSIONID and invalidates the old CSRF token. Run Authentication > Session > Refresh CSRF After Login next.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')) throw new Error('Run Authentication > Session > Get CSRF first.');

request.description: Logs in the bootstrapped admin with the current six-digit TOTP code. Successful login rotates JSESSIONID and CSRF. Run Authentication > Session > Refresh CSRF After Login next.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('csrfToken')) throw new Error('Run Authentication > Session > Get CSRF first.');

item.name: Brand
item.description: Current brand profile; requires brand login.

item.name: Branches
item.description: Create a branch after brand registration and login. Select open days and hours explicitly; omitted days are closed. Monday–Saturday 08:00–20:00 is an editable example, not a server default.

request.description: Edit name, address and workingHours. Each row is an interval on an open day. Saves branchId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const branches = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('branchId', branches.length ? branches[0].id : ''); }

request.description: Reads the weekly schedule. Omitted days are closed.
Replaces ALL weekly hours. Multiple intervals per day are allowed without overlap. An empty workingHours array closes every day.

item.name: Specific Date
item.description: Overrides one date only. Closing the branch makes all employee effective hours empty. Reset restores the weekly branch hours. These requests are alternatives, not a scenario to run together.

request.description: dateOverride indicates whether the result comes from a date override or the weekly branch schedule.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('branchId') || !pm.variables.get('scheduleDate')) throw new Error('Set branchId and scheduleDate (YYYY-MM-DD) first.');

request.description: Replaces this date only; may open a normally closed weekday. Today and future dates only.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('branchId') || !pm.variables.get('scheduleDate')) throw new Error('Set branchId and scheduleDate (YYYY-MM-DD) first.');

request.description: Closes the entire branch for this date, including employees with custom hours.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('branchId') || !pm.variables.get('scheduleDate')) throw new Error('Set branchId and scheduleDate (YYYY-MM-DD) first.');

request.description: Removes only the date override. Restores the brand-defined weekly hours; does not delete the branch.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('branchId') || !pm.variables.get('scheduleDate')) throw new Error('Set branchId and scheduleDate (YYYY-MM-DD) first.');

item.name: Services
item.description: Brand-wide service catalog. Get Own Services saves serviceId.

request.description: Log in as a brand and refresh CSRF first. The brand ID comes from the session.
Saves the first service ID as serviceId for assignment requests. You can select another ID in collection variables.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const services = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('serviceId', services.length ? services[0].id : ''); }

item.name: Validation Checks
item.description: Deliberately invalid requests; each should return 400.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.test('displayName has a validation error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.have.property('displayName'));
if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.test('displayName has a validation error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.have.property('displayName'));
if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.test('durationMinutes has a validation error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.have.property('durationMinutes'));

item.name: Employees
item.description: Requires brand login. Select branchId using Branches > Get Own Branches; Add Employee saves employeeId.

item.name: Service Assignments
item.description: Use employeeId from Add Employee and serviceId from Services > Get Own Services. Assign adds the link; unassign removes only the link.

request.description: Requires brand login, refreshed CSRF, employeeId and serviceId. Both records must belong to the logged-in brand.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Assignment matches requested IDs', () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.employeeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('employeeId')); pm.expect(a.serviceId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('serviceId')); });

request.description: Lists the services assigned to employeeId. An employee with no assignments returns an empty array.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Assigned services are returned as an array', () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); rows.forEach(row => { pm.expect(row.employeeId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('employeeId')); pm.expect(row.serviceDetails.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(row.serviceDetails.displayName).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(row.serviceDetails.durationMinutes).to.be.above(0); }); });

item.description: Run duplicate validation after assigning, before unassigning.

item.name: Working Hours
item.description: Choose an existing employeeId belonging to the logged-in brand. Weekly Schedule controls recurring hours; Specific Date controls one date. Get Employee and Get Weekly Hours must use the same employeeId and session.

item.name: Weekly Schedule
item.description: Employee day overrides: workingHours overrides named weekdays; closedDays explicitly closes days; all other days inherit the branch. PUT replaces the set of overrides. Date overrides take priority.

request.description: workingHours combines custom and inherited weekly intervals within branch limits. configuredHours contains employee-only intervals; closedDays names explicit closures; inheritedDays names days using branch hours. usesBranchHours=true only if every day inherits. Date overrides are resolved by Get Effective Hours for Date.

item.name: Appointments
item.description: Appointment creation and availability. PENDING/APPROVED appointments block time. Overlapping creation returns 409; V17 protects concurrent writes. Both creation endpoints require active subscription and branch acceptance. Otherwise 409 explains the reason. Customer creation requires a single-use phone verification token. Dev profile logs SMS codes; production provider is not configured.

request.description: Set employeeId, assigned serviceId and scheduleDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Missing employee weekday settings inherit the branch date hours. closedDays explicitly closes weekly days; an empty employee date override closes that date. Branch closure and inactive employees always yield no times. Starts are at least one hour ahead in Europe/Istanbul. No request body; PENDING/APPROVED appointments are subtracted.

exec: for (const key of ['employeeId', 'serviceId']) { if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(pm.variables.get(key) || '')) throw new Error('Set ' + key + ' to an existing UUID. Check environment overrides.'); }
if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(pm.variables.get('scheduleDate') || '')) throw new Error('Set scheduleDate in YYYY-MM-DD format.');

pm.test('Slots are ordered time strings', () => { pm.expect(result.localTimes).to.be.an('array'); result.localTimes.forEach(t => pm.expect(t).to.match(/^\d{2}:\d{2}(:\d{2}(\.\d+)?)?$/)); pm.expect(result.localTimes).to.eql([...result.localTimes].sort()); });

request.description: Login as owning BRAND and refresh CSRF. No one-hour or past-time restriction for BRAND. Employee must be active, service assigned and the complete appointment must fit working hours. Requires subscriptionActive=true for the brand account and acceptingAppointments=true for the branch. Disabled settings return 409 without creating a booking.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentId', a.id); pm.test('Appointment matches request', () => { pm.expect(a.employeeId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('employeeId')); pm.expect(a.serviceId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('serviceId')); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(Date.parse(a.endsAt) - Date.parse(a.startsAt)).to.eql(a.durationMinutes * 60000); }); }

request.description: First run Create Appointment as Brand successfully. Keep the same employee/date/startTime and submit again; expect 409. Requires V17 for concurrency protection. Requires subscriptionActive=true for the brand account and acceptingAppointments=true for the branch. Disabled settings return 409 without creating a booking.

Get CSRF first. Dev profile logs DEV SMS with the last four phone digits and code. Set smsCode from that log. Code TTL 2 minutes, resend wait 60 seconds, max 3 sends in a rolling hour per phone. Production without provider returns 503. No automatic SMS retry.
Enter the six-digit code from the dev log. At most three wrong guesses; expired, exhausted or already verified codes are rejected. Response token is valid for five minutes and one booking.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const result = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('phoneVerificationToken', result.verificationToken); pm.test('Token expires', () => pm.expect(Date.parse(result.expiresAt)).to.be.above(Date.now())); }

request.description: For an anonymous test, log out then GET /api/auth/csrf again; retain the new cookie and token. Employee must belong to branchId. Start must be at least one hour ahead in Europe/Istanbul. Run Request SMS Code then Verify SMS Code first. Token is bound to customerPhone, expires after 5 minutes and is consumed only by a successful booking. Omit customerEmail to test optional email. Requires subscriptionActive=true for the brand account and acceptingAppointments=true for the branch. Disabled settings return 409 without creating a booking.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentId', a.id); pm.test('Appointment matches request', () => { pm.expect(a.employeeId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('employeeId')); pm.expect(a.serviceId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('serviceId')); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(Date.parse(a.endsAt) - Date.parse(a.startsAt)).to.eql(a.durationMinutes * 60000); }); }

item.name: Approval and Rejection
item.description: Manual alternatives: approve one PENDING appointment or reject another. Rejection keeps the record and releases its time. Do not run both success requests on the same appointmentId.

request.description: Login as the owning BRAND and refresh CSRF. Set appointmentId to a PENDING appointment (creation saves it automatically). No body. Success returns 200 with an empty body. Approve and Reject require separate PENDING appointments. Missing or another brand’s appointment returns 404. A non-PENDING appointment returns 409.

exec: if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(pm.variables.get('appointmentId') || '')) throw new Error('Set appointmentId to an existing appointment UUID.');

request.description: Run the matching action successfully first, then repeat with the same appointmentId. Expect 409.
